text:
sam: hi folks! a couple quick onboarding logistics: where do I drop my new hire forms? and which channels should I keep notifications on for infra vs product updates?

rita: hey @sam welcome! drop signed forms in the #new-hires thread and @people-ops (julie) will confirm. product updates: join #product and #product-announce (read-only for most). infra/drift/ops: #eng-infra and #eng-sre.

sam: thanks. any rules about asking quick config questions in eng channels? i don’t want to interrupt standups.

infra-team: short answer: use threads for follow-ups, prefix urgent pings with "URGENT:" and only @oncall for production incidents. For config stuff, post in #eng-infra or #devex depending on topic; include code snippet or command you ran.

sam: good call. how do i get the ci notifications turned on for my repo?

dev-bot: To subscribe: in #release-notifs run `@releases subscribe repo=org/repo`. You'll get a DM to confirm.

rita: also FYI: mute noisy channels (like #random) and set notification preferences per channel to "mentions only" for high-traffic ones. :slightly_smiling_face:

sam: awesome, that clears it up. posting forms now and will subscribe to release-notifs.

onboard-bot: Thanks @sam! Your form was received. People Ops will reach out if anything else is needed.
